description: Maian vehicle V3 (Mike 2026-11-16): boost and heat. The Maian hover vehicle mod (built by the in-game mod author from dev-mods/maian_hover_vehicle/recipe.json, with behavior/variables.json, pd.vehicle_variables.v1) replaces CI training's hoverbike and is driven. Holding the new mappable boost action (ACTION_VEHICLE_BOOST, Shift / controller A) ramps the boost to full in about 1 s; after about 4 s of boost the crystals overheat: the seafoam crystal part (140) is hidden so the black ones inside it show, boost drops to its cap, steering is limited briefly and the turret is locked (logged until V5 reads it); letting go recovers the crystals in 2 to 4 s depending on speed. Runs on Escape (--launch-mission base:escape). The mount hook places Player 0 beside the bike with chrMoveToPos, which now skips the body model a solo player does not have outside a cutscene (B-1158; the hook used to wait for that model, which never came, so it never mounted on any campaign stage). Escape starts with the player pushing the hover bed (grab mode, as in the original; B-1159, not a bug): after the intro is skipped, one direct-activate press (ACTION_VEHICLE_USE, E) lets go of it, and the mount hook, which waits for walk mode, fires. Screenshots: full boost, black crystals, recovering, cool. The mount hook mounts in the same frame walk mode comes back, so the smoke waits only for vehicle_driver_ready after that press (an on-foot wait there never comes true: 2026-11-16 08:48 UTC runs).

input_sequence.comment: Escape is live and its intro is playing.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_SKIP_CUTSCENE
input_sequence.comment: Skip the intro. The stage then has the player grab the hover bed.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_VEHICLE_USE
input_sequence.comment: Let go of the hover bed: a direct activate in grab mode drops it and gives walk mode back. Only once: a second press could grab it again. The armed mount hook mounts in that same frame.
Player 0 is mounted on the Maian vehicle and driving through LAYER_VEHICLE_DRIVER.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_VEHICLE_ACCELERATE
input_sequence.comment: Drive forward, so the input line and the speed-scaled recovery have speed.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_VEHICLE_BOOST
input_sequence.comment: Hold boost: ramping, full after about 1 s (turret locked), overheated after about 4 s.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_VEHICLE_BOOST
input_sequence.comment: Let go after 5.5 s: the crystals stay black while they recover.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_VEHICLE_ACCELERATE
input_sequence.comment: Slow down; recovery is faster at low speed.
Scripted exit once the crystals are cool again (2 to 4 s after letting go).
